exact_head_binding.self_reference_policy: This committed evidence records the latest verified code ancestor. Final exact-head proof is the GitHub Actions run and Codex review attached to the final PR HEAD, avoiding an impossible self-referential commit SHA.

gates.closure_rule: Do not mark Wave 1 technically green until this evidence commit itself has successful exact-head Factory CI, successful PRE-PROD App Build, and an exact-head Codex review with zero open P1/P2.

changelog: Introduced deterministic LOCAL-001 selection with exact company, engine and version precedence before GLOBAL fallbacks.
Introduced FREE-001 free-first broker with zero-cost precedence, confidence filtering and strict boolean execution flags.
Introduced local DBOFF-001/STOROFF-001 offload stores with dense-snapshot validation, scoped backup/restore and recovery after ambiguous journal durability.
Rejects SharedArrayBuffer and shared-memory views using intrinsic backing-buffer inspection before durable persistence.
Requires distinct DBOFF/STOROFF/AIBUD journal paths to preserve rebuild integrity.
Prepared restore tokens are opaque, single-use and revision-bound; stale tokens fail closed so later cross-scope writes remain durable.
Introduced deterministic AIBUD-001/ROUTE-001 routing with HUMAN_REQUIRED gates.
Persisted route/cost decision evidence across rebuilds.
Introduced isolated integration harness with zero-cost/no-Supabase-PREPROD contract.
